title: Reversi tool manifest
description: Declares how reversible one tool is, what undoes it, and which permission it needs. A manifest file is one of these or an array of them (JSON or YAML).

effect.description: read_only: no external change. idempotent: safe to retry, no undo needed. reversible: a true inverse exists. compensable: a counteraction exists but leaves residue (a refund appears on a statement). irreversible: no safe undo.

approval.description: always makes a human approve each call. Forced to always for irreversible tools.

argument_map.description: Compensation argument name to a reference: $args.path (the original call) or $result.path (what the tool returned).

requires.description: Tools that must have succeeded earlier in the same run. Also creates rollback ordering edges.
